correctness.rationale: For a vertex in part V_i, the open neighborhood is exactly the union of all other parts. Thus an empty label is legal exactly when each color has support outside V_i. This proves the iff criterion. The multinomial count partitions all labelings uniquely by per-part label counts. The minimum-weight lower bounds follow from the number of part-color incidences forced by empty vertices. Exhaustive replay through order 8 agrees on 1,653,904 assignments and all 818 checked coefficients.

value.rationale: The complete-multipartite family is a standard test class for domination variants. The theorem replaces minimum-only information with an exact description of every feasible 2-rainbow function and a closed finite profile sum for the entire weight distribution. The support obstruction is structural and can be used for coefficient extraction, counting, and probabilistic questions, so the result is more than a routine restatement of the scalar parameter.
